key_points: Charles Schwab announced a secondary listing on the Texas Stock Exchange, primarily a procedural move.
Updates to the AI client assistant now allow clients to modify watchlists and add beneficiaries.
Discussion of a potential private markets initiative via a Forge partnership was highlighted in media.
Several articles characterize the stock as potentially undervalued following a recent pullback.
No earnings, guidance, or material corporate actions were reported; most headlines are general commentary.
